title: Tennis no Ouji-sama: Zenkoku Taikai-hen Semifinal
summary: AniList 2752 is the MIDDLE installment of the three-part Nationals OVA chain (995 Zenkoku Taikai-hen, 13 eps -> 2752 Semifinal, 6 eps -> 4053 Final, 7 eps), released on three DVDs 2007-06-22 (BCBA-2985), 2007-09-25 (BCBA-2986) and 2008-01-25 (BCBA-2987) and numbered by the licensor 第1話-第6話 (tenipuri.jp per-disc pages; the Blu-ray BOX BCXA-1378 prints 【6話収録】 and 本編136分). It animates the National semifinal, Seigaku vs Shitenhouji, plus the Rikkaidai vs Nagoya Seitoku cross-cut and the Ryoma/Kintaro one-point match: Genius 305/306-340 in Konomi's printed Genius numbering, ending on Genius 340 「テニスの王子達へ」 (Towards the Princes of Tennis), the last chapter of volume 38 before the yakiniku party. BOTH EDGES RECONCILE WITH THE SIBLINGS. The END is exact and now confirmed from both sides: this work stops at 340 and the Final's ep 0 opens on the NEXT chapter, Genius 341 「今夜は焼肉パーティーだ！」 (the 4053 verdict, verified independently here against the licensor's Final Vol.0 page and the fandom's ep-20 field) - a clean seam with no overlap. The START is Genius 305 as a SEAM SHARE, not a fresh start: 995's last episode 「死闘・帝王VS王子様」 and this work's ep 1 「四天宝寺VS不動峰」 both carry Genius 305 「初の敗北」, the chapter that closes the Hyotei quarterfinal, and two independent summary lineages put the match's finish inside THIS episode (en-WP/fandom: 'End of Singles 1 match between Hyotei and Seigaku'; tenipuri.info: 'Seigaku finish their last match against Hyoutei'), while the licensor's blurb for 995 ep 13 stops on a cliffhanger that never states the outcome ('絶体絶命のリョーマ。勝機はあるか・・・'). This work's OWN story - the Shitenhouji arc - starts at Genius 306 「2人の王子様」, which is exactly where tenipuri.info's chapter guide draws the arc boundary. Standing is canon: I hunted for an original share and found none. All six episodes are manga matches in manga order, at 136 minutes for 36 chapters (~3.8 min/chapter, ~5 pages/min) there is no room for one, ja-Wikipedia says the OVA 原作の展開を踏襲した and explicitly notes that it does NOT carry the TV series' own filler (Kirihara's reform in the anime-only Junior Selection arc, TV ep 138, is not reflected), tenipuri.info's 'Filler?' column is empty on all six rows, and the fandom's per-episode 'Anime and Manga Differences' lists are one or two items each - reorders, cuts, a censored panel and one added scene (Chitose's resignation shown rather than mentioned) - i.e. faithfulness-clause divergences under T28.

chapters_adapted.note: EPISODE 1 「四天宝寺VS不動峰」 (licensor #1; wiki/dAnime numbering OVA ep 14), DVD Vol.1, 2007-06-22 - THE SEAM SHARE. Genius 305 「初の敗北」 (First Defeat) closes the Hyotei quarterfinal and is listed by the fandom on BOTH 995's ep 13 (296-305) and this episode (305-313); en-WP's and the fandom's summary says this episode contains the 'End of Singles 1 match between Hyotei and Seigaku' and tenipuri.info says 'Seigaku finish their last match against Hyoutei', and the licensor's blurb opens on the result as established fact ('氷帝との激闘を制し、準決勝進出を決めた青春学園'). weight: sliver - because the match's outcome is 995's beat, not this work's: whichever pages of 305 land here they are the tail of a chapter the previous installment carries, they occupy the opening minutes only, and this work's own story (the Shitenhouji arc) begins at 306. It is canon material either way - no source calls it recycled footage - so it is recorded, not counted. What is NOT settled: whether the frames are re-shown (a recap share, weightless under T28) or 305's untouched closing pages newly animated (the shaving payoff / Hyotei's farewell). See the boundary flag.

EPISODE 1 「四天宝寺VS不動峰」 (OVA ep 14), DVD Vol.1, 2007-06-22 - the work's real opening: Ryoma's reunion with Kintaro, the OTHER quarterfinal (Shitenhouji vs Fudomine) and the semifinal order. Genius 306 「2人の王子様」 (Two Princes - the Ryoma/Kintaro reunion, and the chapter tenipuri.info's chapter guide makes the first of the Shitenhouji arc) through Genius 313 「オーダー発表」 (Order Announced). Two-source lock: the licensor's Vol.1 synopsis walks the chapter titles in order - the Kintaro reunion (306), Kintaro crushing Ibu in the Fudomine tie (307 四天宝寺の実力), Kamio & Ishida losing Doubles 2, then Singles 2 Chitose vs Tachibana and the 因縁 between the two former Kyushu team-mates (308 あの人に一歩でも近づきたくて / 309 けじめ); the Blu-ray BOX and dAnime copy names 「才気煥発の極み」 outright, which is Genius 312's own title. 313's order announcement must sit here because episode 2's licensor blurb opens on 「青学の準決勝第１ゲーム・シングルス３」. Faithfulness-clause divergences recorded by the fandom: Kintaro's match with Ibu is unfinished when he meets Ryoma (finished in the manga), Inui/Kikumaru/Momoshiro stay hidden during that meeting, Chitose's resignation is SHOWN (only mentioned in the manga), and Chitose reveals the Pinnacle of Perfection off court rather than on it.

EPISODE 2 「咆哮」 (OVA ep 15), DVD Vol.1, 2007-06-22 - Singles 3, Fuji vs Shiraishi, the whole match. Genius 314 「熱闘！青学VS四天宝寺」 through Genius 321 「終止符」 (Period). Two-source lock at both ends: the licensor's synopsis names 「四天宝寺の聖書（バイブル）」 (315 完璧なる男 / 318 聖書VS天才), 「追い詰められ窮地の不二」 (317 不二必死), the completion of the final counter 「百腕巨人（ヘカトンケイル）の門番」 (319 その門は固く閉ざされた), and closes on 「そして遂に、決着の時はきた・・・」 = 321's title 終止符. Divergences: Fudomine and St. Rudolph are shown watching in the manga; Shiraishi's Entaku Shot is not directly seen in the anime.

EPISODE 3 「お笑いテニスの恐怖」 (OVA ep 16), DVD Vol.2, 2007-09-25 - Doubles 2, Momoshiro/Kaido vs Koharu/Hitouji. Genius 321 「終止符」 (SHARED with episode 2 - the Fuji/Shiraishi aftermath carried over; en-WP's ep-2 summary itself says Kawamura's reaction to Fuji 'is noted in the following episode') through Genius 327 「ライバルだからこそ」 (Because We Are Rivals), the match's close. The episode takes its title from Genius 322 「お笑いテニスの恐怖」. Licensor beats map in order: the Koharu/Hitouji gag tennis (322/323 コメプリ/326 モノマネ王子), Koharu's IQ-200 data play exposing Kaido's private life (324/325), and 「スミレの煽りにひらめいた桃城は隠し持っていたある秘密兵器を装着する」 = the masks of Genius 324 「ポーカーフェイスを手に入れろ！！」. Divergences: the mask-removal timing, and Koharu impersonating the referee in the manga too.

EPISODE 4 「青学のお荷物」 (OVA ep 17), DVD Vol.2, 2007-09-25 - Singles 2, Kawamura vs Ishida Gin. Genius 327 (SHARED with episode 3, the hand-off to the next match - the licensor opens on 「続く試合は河村と四天宝寺・石田のパワー対決だ」) through Genius 332 「お膳立て」 (The Stage is Set, SHARED with episode 5). The episode takes its title from Genius 329 「青学のお荷物」. Two-source lock in the middle: 「波動球の生みの親である石田」 = 328 「本家」 (Creator); 「そんな姿に感服した石田は百八段階まである波動球を発動する」 = 330 「最大の礼儀」 (The Greatest Respect); Kawamura's Final Hadoukyuu and win = 331 「最後のテニス」 (The Last Tennis Match). Divergences: Ryoma's added tease about 108 Hadoukyuu styles; Kawamura's blood toned down. NOTE: the fandom's field on this row also prints a stray 「Genius 321: Period」 ahead of 327 - see the field-artifact flag; it is excluded here.

EPISODE 5 「二つの扉」 (OVA ep 18), DVD Vol.3, 2008-01-25 - Doubles 1, which becomes Tezuka vs Chitose when Inui and Zaizen stand aside. Genius 331 「最後のテニス」 (SHARED with episode 4, the Kawamura aftermath) and 332 「お膳立て」 - the licensor's synopsis is 332's content verbatim ('不動峰・橘との試合の後、退部届けを出していた千歳がオサムの粋な取り計らいで、エントリーされていた') - through Genius 336 「最終決戦」, Tezuka's 6-1 win. Two-source lock: 「「百錬自得の極み」と「才気煥発の極み」を発動！」 is Genius 333's own title 「百錬自得VS才気煥発」; the second door of Muga no Kyochi is 335 「己の限界点」; 334 「絶対予告」 sits between. One divergence recorded: Chitose answers the Tezuka Zone with a smash in the anime, a drop shot in the manga.

EPISODE 5 「二つの扉」 (OVA ep 18), the B-plot - Genius 338 「悪魔」 (Devil) OUT OF ORDER, ahead of 337. The episode closes on the other semifinal, Rikkaidai vs Nagoya Seitoku, with Kirihara bloodied and driven into the fence: the licensor's synopsis ends 「王者・立海が外国人選手で固めた名古屋星徳に思わぬ苦戦を強いられていたのだ。先輩たちのふがいなさに業をにやす切原だが‥」. weight: sliver - because it is the opening beat of a cross-cut whose payoff (Kirihara's transformation) is in episode 6, which carries 338 properly along with 337 and 339; here it is a few minutes of set-up on a hook. This is a rearrangement, not new coverage: the chapter is adapted in full across episodes 5 and 6.

EPISODE 6 「一球勝負！」 (OVA ep 19), DVD Vol.3, 2008-01-25 - the finale, and THE END OF THIS WORK. Genius 336 「最終決戦」 (SHARED with episode 5 - the licensor opens 「ついに青春学園VS四天宝寺の準決勝の決着がついた。健闘をたたえあう両校」) through Genius 340 「テニスの王子達へ」 (Towards the Princes of Tennis), the last chapter of volume 38 before the yakiniku party. It carries Genius 337 「激突！1球勝負 越前リョーマVS遠山金太郎」 (the licensor's 「野試合をしようとリョーマに持ちかけ、１球だけという条件で」 is that chapter), the rest of 338 「悪魔」 (「怒りに打ち震えるその体には新たな進化の兆しが！」), and 339 「1球勝負の行方」 (「試合は予想もしえない展開へ！」) - the one-point match that splits the ball in half and ends in a draw. Genius 340 is NOT a partial: it is the semifinal's close and the Final's ep 0 opens on the next chapter, 341. Note the cross-cut order: 338 is broken across episodes 5 and 6 while 337 sits only here, so episode 5 runs ahead of episode 6 on the Rikkai plot - a rearrangement, all of 331-340 covered. One divergence: Nanjiro listens to the match in a taxi rather than at the family shrine.

position.why: AFTER THE WHOLE TV RUN and SECOND in the OVA chain - confirmed on three orderings that agree. (1) Air date: TV ep 178 2005-03-30; 995 2006-03-24 -> 2007-03-23; this work 2007-06-22 -> 2008-01-25; 4053 2008-04-25 -> 2009-01-23 (AniList API; ja-WP's OVA release table; en-WP's OVA prose citing Bandai Visual BCBA-2985 / BCBA-2987; the licensor's own per-disc 発売日). (2) Story: one continuous National Tournament - Higa/Hyotei quarterfinals (995) -> the Shitenhouji semifinal (this) -> the Rikkaidai final and epilogue (4053). (3) Chapter order: 995 ends on Genius 305, this work runs 305/306-340, the Final opens on 341 - no fraction inside or before the chain is possible. So the .51 slot is right IF AND ONLY IF 995 holds 178.50 and 4053 holds 178.52, which is exactly the cluster the sibling verdict assumes; all three orderings agree on that sequence, so if the cluster is currently held in any other order the fix is a reorder, not a change to this row.

flags_for_sean: BOUNDARY SCENE 1 - THE START IS A SEAM SHARE ON GENIUS 305, AND ONE HALF OF IT IS UNSETTLED. Genius 305 「初の敗北」 (First Defeat, vol 35) is the chapter that closes the Hyotei quarterfinal, and the fandom's fields put it on BOTH 995's last episode 「死闘・帝王VS王子様」 (296-305) and this work's first episode 「四天宝寺VS不動峰」 (305-313). What I can prove with two independent lineages: the finish of that match is INSIDE this episode - en-WP's and the fandom's summary both open with 'End of Singles 1 match between Hyotei and Seigaku', and the self-hosted tenipuri.info wiki says 'Seigaku finish their last match against Hyoutei and go to watch Fudoumine vs. Shitenhouji'. Two further facts point the same way: en-WP's summary of 995 ep 13 stops at 'the two go into what seems like a never-ending tie-break' without stating a winner, and the licensor's own blurb for that disc ends on 「絶体絶命のリョーマ。勝機はあるか・・・」 - teaser wording, no outcome; and this episode's licensor cast list carries Atobe (諏訪部順一), Shishido and Oshitari, who have nothing to do with the Fudomine tie. WHAT IS NOT SETTLED: whether those frames are RE-SHOWN (a recap share, weightless under T28) or Genius 305's untouched closing pages animated for the first time (the shaved-head payoff, Hyotei's farewell - volume 35's Viz title is literally 'Farewell, Hyoutei Gakuen'). No source I could read states it either way, and the one fan review that appeared to describe the opening (note.com/canaria_cosmos) has been deleted (404 live and no Wayback capture). I have therefore booked 305 as its own SLIVER entry with the ambiguity named, and set this work's significant coverage to begin at Genius 306 「2人の王子様」 - which is exactly where tenipuri.info's chapter guide ends the Hyoutei arc and starts the Shitenhouji arc. EITHER WAY THE CHAIN HAS NO GAP: if 995's terminal is 305 (the wave-2 triage's value), 305 is a straddle and nothing is unadapted at the seam. What would settle it: three minutes of the episode.

BOUNDARY SCENE 2 - THE END IS GENIUS 340, AND THE SIBLING'S START CONFIRMS IT FROM THE OTHER SIDE. Episode 6 「一球勝負！」 ends on Genius 340 「テニスの王子達へ」 (Towards the Princes of Tennis) - the last chapter of volume 38 before the yakiniku party, i.e. the semifinal's close: the one-point match ends in a draw when the ball splits in half, Kintaro and Ryoma part, Rikkaidai take the other semifinal. 340 is NOT a partial and there is no tail: the Final (4053) opens its ep 0 on the NEXT chapter, Genius 341 「今夜は焼肉パーティーだ！」, with the party itself as its first scene - the 4053 verdict established that from its side, and I confirmed it independently here (the fandom's ep-20 field reads 341-344; the licensor's Final Vol.0 synopsis walks those four chapter titles; the Semifinal's own Vol.3 synopsis has no yakiniku in it). Chapter space: printed Genius numbering. Volume 38 = Genius 332-341 on TWO sources that agree everywhere in this range (en-WP's Shueisha-cited volume list - the seam I checked is vol 37 = 322-331 / vol 38 = 332-341, and both lists break at the same chapter - and tenipuri.info's chapter guide, which prints a Vol.# per chapter: 336, 337, 338, 339, 340, 341 all '38'). The fandom's own VolumeNav on the Genius 340 page agrees (prev pv037 / next pv039).

THE STRUCTURE FLAG (yours to decide, not mine) - THIS CHAIN CONTINUES THE ADAPTATION, IT DOES NOT DECORATE IT. Facts a component ruling would need for THIS work. (a) COUNT - 6 episodes, numbered 第1話 to 第6話 by the licensor within the Semifinal (tenipuri.jp per-disc pages print 収録 #1-#6; the Blu-ray BOX BCXA-1378 prints 【6話収録】 and lists all six with 第6話（最終話）). AniList's 6, dAnime's 全6話 and thetv.jp's 第1話-第6話 all agree. (b) RUNTIME - 本編136分 + 特典6分 (BCXA-1378), i.e. ~22.7 min/episode, three DVDs of 約46分 each. (c) DATES - Vol.1 2007-06-22 (BCBA-2985), Vol.2 2007-09-25 (BCBA-2986), Vol.3 2008-01-25 (BCBA-2987); ja-WP's OVA table and en-WP's OVA prose (citing Bandai Visual's product pages) agree with the licensor exactly. (d) NAMING - the licensor calls it 「テニスの王子様 Original Video Animation 全国大会篇 Semifinal」 and shelves the three OVA series together as 「テニスの王子様 OVA 全国大会篇シリーズ Blu-ray BOX」; en-WP describes all three as 'a three original video animation (OVA) series which adapted the National Tournament arc'. (e) CONTINUOUS NUMBERING EXISTS - dAnime titles these six episodes 'Episode 14' to 'Episode 19', i.e. continuously with 995's 1-13, and so do en-WP ('OVA series Episodes 14-19'), the fandom wiki and Rakuten TV; only the licensor's own discs restart at 1 per series. (f) BROADCAST - these are not disc-only: TV Tokyo aired Semifinal + Final as 「テニスの王子様 ベストマッチ」 2011-10-05 to 2011-12-28, and TV Tokyo's 2021 新生劇場版公開記念「テニスの王子様 全国大会篇」セレクション ran 全国大会篇 + Semifinal + Final 2021-04-06 to 2021-09-28 (ja-WP). (g) COVERAGE - MangaUpdates books the whole run as ONE segment, anime.end 'Vol 42, Chap 379 (Including OVA)'; it does not split the OVAs out. Filed today as a related work by FORMAT (OVA); by content it is 36 chapters of the manga's back half that no episode row in the catalog carries.

T28 SIZING, ON THE RECORD - THERE IS NO ROOM FOR AN ORIGINAL SHARE. 本編136分 over 6 episodes for Genius 305/306-340 = 36 chapters is ~3.8 min/chapter; Prince of Tennis chapters run ~19-20 pages, so ~5.2 pages/minute, against the TV run's ~2 chapters per 22-minute episode (~1.8 pages/min). This is abridged adaptation, not a source share beside an original share. Every one of the six episodes IS a manga match in manga order (Singles 3 Fuji/Shiraishi, Doubles 2 Momoshiro-Kaido/Koharu-Hitouji, Singles 2 Kawamura/Gin, Doubles 1 Tezuka/Chitose, the Rikkai-Nagoya cross-cut, the Ryoma/Kintaro one-point match), and nothing is omitted at match granularity - Seigaku take the tie 3-1 and Singles 1 is never played, exactly as in the manga, which is why Kintaro asks for the one-point match. Positive statements of standing: ja-WP says the OVA 原作の展開を踏襲した and, in the same sentence, that BECAUSE it follows the manga it does NOT reflect the anime's own filler (Kirihara's change of heart in the anime-only Junior Selection arc, TV ep 138); tenipuri.info's 'Filler?' column - which it does populate for the TV run's filler arcs - is empty on all six Semifinal rows. The only additions the fandom records are one added scene (Chitose's resignation shown rather than mentioned), one reorder (Kintaro's match with Ibu unfinished when he meets Ryoma), two cuts (Fudomine/St. Rudolph watching, Shiraishi's Entaku Shot), a censored panel (Kawamura's blood) and two one-line gags. Faithfulness clause, not mixed.

SOURCE TIERS - WHAT IS TWO-SOURCE HERE AND WHAT IS NOT. The per-episode CHAPTER NUMBERS come from ONE lineage: the Prince of Tennis Wiki's 'Manga Chapter Equivalents' fields, all six added in a single sitting by Bobbycat1 on 2015-02-26 (page histories and the One-Point Match diff 34755->42826 checked). No second list of numbers per episode exists - AFL and AFG have no Prince of Tennis page, programming-cafe 404s, ja-WP's OVA table has no 原作 column, and the second wiki (tenipuri.info) gives per-episode MATCH summaries but no chapter numbers. What IS independent, and what every number above is corroborated against, is (i) the licensor's per-episode synopses (tenipuri.jp, live pages plus the 2008 Wayback captures) matched against the Shueisha-sourced chapter TITLES on en-WP's volume list, and (ii) tenipuri.info's chapter guide, which reproduces the same titles and volume numbers and additionally draws the arc boundary at 305/306. The title match is evidential, not decorative: ep 2's synopsis closes on 「決着の時はきた」 = Genius 321 「終止符」 and names 319's gate; ep 4's names 328 「本家」 and 330 「最大の礼儀」; ep 5's contains Genius 333's title 「百錬自得VS才気煥発」 verbatim; ep 6's is Genius 337's premise and 339's outcome; the Blu-ray BOX copy names Genius 312 「才気煥発の極み」; and two episodes take their titles from chapters (322 -> ep 3, 329 -> ep 4). The fields also pass an internal credibility test - contiguous 305-340 with genuine straddles at 321, 327, 331-332 and 336, and a real out-of-order detail (338 in episode 5 while 337 is only in episode 6, the Rikkai/Nagoya cross-cut). Confidence high on the span and the standing; the softest parts are the exact page splits at the five straddled chapters and the 305 seam.

A FIELD ARTIFACT ON EPISODE 4 (OVA 17). Bobbycat1's field for 「青学のお荷物」 reads 'Genius 321: Period' followed by 327-332. Genius 321 is the close of the Fuji/Shiraishi match and he had already placed it on episode 2 (as its climax) and episode 3 (as its carried-over aftermath); nothing in the licensor's Vol.2 synopsis for episode 4, nor in either wiki's summary of it, involves the Fuji match. I have excluded 321 from episode 4's range and named it here rather than folding it in silently. It changes nothing: 321 is covered by episodes 2 and 3 either way, and the run 305-340 is contiguous with or without it.

A DATE DEFECT IN THE ENGLISH LINEAGE (not ours, but it will be quoted at us). en-WP's episode list and the fandom both date episodes 16 and 17 'September 28, 2007', and tenipuri.info copies it. The licensor and ja-WP both say Semifinal Vol.2 (#3 「お笑いテニスの恐怖」 / #4 「青学のお荷物」) shipped 2007年9月25日, sell and rental on the same day, 品番 BCBA-2986. Our stored row is unaffected - it carries the work's first release, 2007-06-22, which every source agrees on, and AniList's end 2008-01-25 matches Vol.3 exactly - so no repair is proposed; noted so that a later pass does not 'correct' our value to the wiki's.

REPAIRS: NONE - ALL FOUR STORED FACTS CONFIRMED. Title 'Tennis no Ouji-sama: Zenkoku Taikai-hen Semifinal' = AniList romaji, native テニスの王子様 全国大会篇 Semifinal, licensor 「テニスの王子様 Original Video Animation 全国大会篇 Semifinal」. Date 2007-06-22 = the licensor's Vol.1 発売日 and ja-WP's table. Kind 'ova' = AniList format OVA and the licensor's own 'Original Video Animation' branding. AniList's ADAPTATION edge names manga 30049 'Tennis no Ouji-sama', which IS the owner's instrument and IS what this work adapts - consistent with the finding. Episode count 6 confirmed on four sources (AniList, the licensor's discs, the Blu-ray BOX's 【6話収録】, dAnime's 全6話).

T26: KONOMI'S CREDIT IS A CREDIT. Every disc prints 原作：許斐 剛（集英社『週刊少年ジャンプ』連載）. That is a source credit on an adaptation; it puts nothing INTO the manga line (the chapters this work animates, Genius 305-340, were serialized 2005-2006 and collected in volumes 35-38 by June 2007, before Vol.1 shipped). `adopted` is null and this stays a note.

DISC EXTRAS THAT ARE NOT EPISODES. Between Semifinal Vol.2 and Vol.3 the licensor released a FAN DISC, 「テニスの王子様 FAN DISC White heat Remix」, 2007-12-21 (ja-WP's OVA table lists it in the same block, unnumbered). It is not one of the six and carries no chapter coverage; noted so nobody later reads it as a seventh episode. The Blu-ray BOX's video extras are non-credit OP/ED and BOX promos only.

THE CHAIN'S LOWER EDGE IS SOMEONE ELSE'S TO SETTLE (relayed, not researched by me). The task framed the chain as animating Genius 237-379. The upper edge is exact (379, via 4053) and the middle is now exact (305/306-340, this verdict). The LOWER edge is 995's, and the 4053 verdict already flagged that the fandom's field on 995's first episode reads Genius 248-253, not 237 - which would leave 237-247 either inside the TV run's tail or unadapted. Please let the 995 agent settle it; my only contribution from this side is that 995's terminal reads 305 on the same field lineage, which is what this work's ep 1 straddles.
